subject: social_studies
concept: Writing a philosophical essay analyzing a real ethical question using structured argumentation and multiple frameworks
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans their essay using a premises/framework-comparison/conclusion organizer
exercise.abstract: Student writes a philosophical essay presenting a structured argument on an ethical question, engaging with more than one framework

assessment.mastery_threshold: essay presents a clear structured argument and engages genuinely with more than one ethical framework
misconception_flags: states a personal opinion without structured argumentation or engagement with any ethical framework

interest_binding: question generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
